mapper.insert: insert into voya_ai_trip (user_id, city_id, title, cover_image, start_date, end_date, people_count, budget, travel_type, description, source, status, del_flag, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{cityId}, #{title}, #{coverImage}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{peopleCount}, #{budget}, #{travelType}, #{description}, #{source}, '0', '0', now(), now())
mapper.update:
update voya_ai_trip
title = #{title}, cover_image = #{coverImage}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, people_count = #{peopleCount}, budget = #{budget}, travel_type = #{travelType}, description = #{description}, source = #{source}, status = #{status}, update_time = now()
where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select t.id, t.city_id as cityId, c.name as cityName, t.title, t.cover_image as coverImage, t.start_date as startDate, t.end_date as endDate, t.people_count as peopleCount, t.budget, t.travel_type as travelType, t.description, t.source, t.status, t.create_time as createTime, t.update_time as updateTime from voya_ai_trip t left join voya_ai_city c on t.city_id = c.id where t.id = #{id} and t.user_id = #{userId} and t.del_flag = '0'

select id, user_id as userId, city_id as cityId, title, cover_image as coverImage, start_date as startDate, end_date as endDate, people_count as peopleCount, budget, travel_type as travelType, description, source, status, del_flag as delFlag, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime from voya_ai_trip where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'

select t.id, t.title, t.cover_image as coverImage, t.start_date as startDate, t.end_date as endDate, t.people_count as peopleCount, t.budget, t.travel_type as travelType, t.source, t.status, c.name as cityName, (select count(*) from voya_ai_trip_day d where d.trip_id = t.id and d.del_flag = '0') as dayCount, t.create_time as createTime from voya_ai_trip t left join voya_ai_city c on t.city_id = c.id where t.user_id = #{userId} and t.del_flag = '0'
and t.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
and t.status = #{status}
order by t.id desc
mapper.update: update voya_ai_trip set del_flag = '1', update_time = now() where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select t.id, t.city_id as cityId, c.name as cityName, u.nickname, u.avatar_url as avatarUrl, t.title, t.cover_image as coverImage, t.start_date as startDate, t.end_date as endDate, t.people_count as peopleCount, t.budget, t.travel_type as travelType, t.description, t.source, t.status, t.create_time as createTime, t.update_time as updateTime from voya_ai_trip t left join voya_ai_city c on t.city_id = c.id left join voya_ai_user u on t.user_id = u.id where t.id = #{id} and t.del_flag = '0'
